nodes.name: index.ts
nodes.summary: Barrel entry point for the tooltip UI component, re-exporting the Root, Trigger, Content, Provider, and Portal parts under both short and prefixed aliases.
nodes.languageNotes: shadcn-svelte barrel that re-exports Svelte component wrappers with dual naming (Root/Tooltip, Content/TooltipContent, etc.).

nodes.name: tooltip-content.svelte
nodes.summary: Styled tooltip content wrapper around bits-ui Tooltip.Content, rendering children inside a portal with an arrow and Tailwind-driven side/state animations.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses Svelte 5 runes ($props, $bindable) and a bits-ui Arrow snippet child; merges classes via the cn() utility.

nodes.name: tooltip-portal.svelte
nodes.summary: Thin pass-through wrapper around the bits-ui Tooltip.Portal primitive that forwards all props.

nodes.name: tooltip-provider.svelte
nodes.summary: Wrapper around the bits-ui Tooltip.Provider primitive that defaults delayDuration to 0 and forwards remaining props.

nodes.name: tooltip-trigger.svelte
nodes.summary: Wrapper around the bits-ui Tooltip.Trigger primitive that binds a ref and tags the element with a data-slot attribute.

nodes.name: tooltip.svelte
nodes.summary: Root tooltip wrapper around the bits-ui Tooltip.Root primitive, exposing a bindable open state and forwarding remaining props.
